newsitem.title: USA: PEPCO 341 MW Md. coal unit back in service.
newsitem.headline: PEPCO 341 MW Md. coal unit back in service.

text.p: Potomac Electric Power Co's (PEPCO) 341 megawatt (MW) unit 1 at its Chalk Point generating complex in Acquasco, Md., resumed operation over the weekend, the company said Monday.
The unit was taken off line Friday when a safety valve problem developed during a restart attempt the same day. Chalk Point 1 was originally shut about Sept 22 to correct a boiler tube leak.
PEPCO is the operator and owner of the Chalk Point facility, which contains four units and installed capacity just above 2,000 MW.
Potomac Electric Power is headquartered in Washington DC.
